[[File:Robert Soare.jpg|thumb|220px|Robert I. Soare]]
'''Robert Irving Soare''' is an American [[mathematician]]. He is the Paul Snowden Russell Distinguished Service Professor of Mathematics and Computer Science at the [[University of Chicago]], where he has been on the faculty since 1967. He proved, together with [[Carl Jockusch]], the [[low basis theorem]], and has done other work in [[mathematical logic]], primarily in the area of [[recursion theory|computability theory]]. His doctoral students at the University of Chicago have included [[Barbara Csima]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=30425}}</ref>

In 2012 he became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180825194636/http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list |date=2018-08-25 }}, retrieved 2013-07-26.</ref>
